items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: Oh, I don't know that fella's name... You know who that is? That's the big banjo player, Hoods.

ctx.x: Oh, I don't know that fella's name. He, he, he wasn't, uh, he was a mellophone player. I believe. No. You know who that is? That's the big banjo player, Hoods. Hoods.
